title: Unit 6 Consolidation: the colonial economy
goal: Review silver mining, forced labour, plantations and slavery, imperial trade and the price of the empire.

items: Talk about the colonial economy with *cuanto más … más …*, impersonal *se*, the passive with *ser*, formal phrases of means and contrast connectors.
Put the main dates of silver and trade in order.
Name the systems of forced labour and the places of the silver and sugar economy.
Use the words of the unit: mine, mita, sugar mill, fleet and price.
Say what silver meant for Spain, for the world and for the colonies.
